anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
No recent learning cycles or AI adjustments have been made, which could suggest issues with AI model training or deployment.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform and may indicate a system or strategy issue.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI system configurations and ensure models are being trained and updated regularly to maintain trading efficiency.
Evaluate the effectiveness and configuration of active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning as intended.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or crashes, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Check AI system logs and configurations to diagnose why no learning cycles or adjustments are occurring.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review and test the active trading strategies to ensure they are correctly configured and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring trading strategies are operational is essential for maintaining platform profitability and user satisfaction.
